messages:
sara-sales: Looping in product about a customer (BigBank EU) asking to add OpenMixtral-7B-Chat v2 to Redwood catalog in eu-west with version pinned to v1. They need region availability + ability to pin to v1 for compliance. Request came from their infra lead. TL;DR: high ARR, regulatory, needs timeline.

jordan-product: Thanks @sara-sales — can you paste the customer's exact ask and priority? Also need to know dedicated/private vs hosted.

sara-sales: They prefer Hosted EU region but will take Dedicated if Hosted not available. Priority: P1 for them (pilot next month). Exact: 'expose openmixtral-7b-chat@v1 in eu-west, disallow v2 for now, and ensure quantized runtime (int8) available'.

maria-cs: +1 urgent. They're worried about model regressions with v2. Also asked for audit logs and KMS. Contact is Elena (infra).

kai-eng-ml: FYI from eng-ml: OpenMixtral v2 changed tokenizer and some attention kernels. Pinning v1 means we must support legacy tokenizer/vocab or run a compatibility shim. Runtime note: v2's kernels may not map cleanly to our optimized paths; need kernel work or fallback.

kai-eng-ml: Short checklist: 1) model files + license 2) quantization profile (int8/4) 3) tokenizer vocab/merges 4) perf baseline in eu instance 5) smoke deployment job. ETA 2-3 weeks if artifacts ready.

jon-product: Proposed triage: accept to backlog as 'catalog_eu_openmixtral_pin' Severity: P1, Customer pilot. Need legal review for license and ops cost estimate.

laura-legal: I can do quick license scan. If model is Apache/MIT we can host; non-commercial-only would block. Please attach license link.

sara-sales: Elena gave a link: https://huggingface.co/openmixtral/openmixtral-7b-chat/blob/main/LICENSE — shows MIT. She also shared model weights location.

laura-legal: MIT is cleared. No IP block.

toni-eng-platform: For eu-west rollout we need to reserve capacity. Ops ask: reserve 1x small GPU pool for pilot and run smoke tests. Also confirm KMS flow for Private deployments.

jon-product: Next steps: 1) create intake ticket, 2) assign to @kai-eng-ml, 3) ask customer for model artifacts + quant profiles + prompt set, 4) legal cleared. Acceptance criteria draft: - correctness >=0.9 on customer eval - p50 latency <350ms in eu host - quantization quality delta <3% - KMS + audit flow verified - rollback policy.

sara-sales: Created PROD-3481: 'Add openmixtral-7b-chat, pin v1 in eu-west, require int8 runtime, KMS + audit logs' https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/PROD-3481 :thumbsup:

maria-cs: Looping Elena — @Elena can you confirm pilot week and upload prompt set to PROD-3481?

elena-cust: Elena: Confirmed pilot target week of 2026-04-18. I'll upload prompt set and model artifacts to the ticket today.

deploy-bot: Ticket PROD-3481 transitioned to 'In Progress' by sara-sales.
